subtasks.instructions: Compute the February 2025 departure delay rate for each carrier AA, AS, B6, DL, UA, and WN. Use the documented definition: a flight is delayed when actual departure minus scheduled departure is more than 15 minutes; delay rate = delayed non-cancelled flights divided by all non-cancelled flights. Restrict to flights whose scheduled departure date/month is February 2025 in local time at the origin airport. For AA, B6, DL, UA, and WN, date and times are already local. AS uses date_utc, sched_dep_utc, and actual_dep_utc: convert scheduled and actual timestamps from UTC to local time using the origin airport's utc_offset_hours, including date rollover, before selecting February and calculating delay minutes. Exclude cancelled flights from both numerator and denominator, and handle delayed departures after midnight correctly. Check for any repeated records and avoid counting duplicate flight_id values more than once. Return counts (delayed, completed), exact percentage, and percentage rounded to one decimal for every carrier; report any assumptions or data-quality issues.

import pandas as pd, numpy as np
from datetime import timedelta
aps=pd.read_csv('airports.csv').set_index('airport')
out={}; issues=[]
for c in ['AA','AS','B6','DL','UA','WN']:
 df=pd.read_csv(f'airlines/{c}.csv')
 dup=df[df.duplicated('flight_id',False)].sort_values('flight_id')
 if len(dup): issues.append(f'{c}: {len(dup)} duplicate rows, {dup.flight_id.nunique()} IDs')
 df=df.drop_duplicates('flight_id',keep='first').copy()
 if c!='AS':
  df['sched_dt']=pd.to_datetime(df['date']+' '+df['sched_dep'], errors='coerce')
  df['actual_dt']=pd.to_datetime(df['date']+' '+df['actual_dep'], errors='coerce')
 else:
  # UTC datetime then offset local
  off=df['origin'].map(aps['utc_offset_hours'])
  df['sched_dt']=pd.to_datetime(df['date_utc']+' '+df['sched_dep_utc'], errors='coerce')+pd.to_timedelta(off,unit='h')
  df['actual_dt']=pd.to_datetime(df['date_utc']+' '+df['actual_dep_utc'], errors='coerce')+pd.to_timedelta(off,unit='h')
 sel=df[(df.sched_dt.dt.year==2025)&(df.sched_dt.dt.month==2)].copy()
 # actual date rollover: if actual clock timestamp constructed same base and earlier, add day
 neg=(sel.actual_dt-sel.sched_dt).dt.total_seconds()<0
 sel.loc[neg,'actual_dt'] += pd.Timedelta(days=1)
 sel['cancelled_bool']=sel.cancelled.astype(str).str.lower().isin(['true','1','yes'])
 comp=sel[~sel.cancelled_bool]
 mins=(comp.actual_dt-comp.sched_dt).dt.total_seconds()/60
 delayed=(mins>15).sum()
 out[c]={'delayed':int(delayed),'completed':int(len(comp)),'exact':delayed/len(comp)*100 if len(comp) else None}
 print(c,'selected',len(sel),'completed',len(comp),'delayed',delayed,'rate',out[c]['exact'],'neg rollover',neg.sum(),'cancel',sel.cancelled_bool.sum())
 print(sel.loc[comp.index[mins>15] if False else [], ['flight_id']])
print('issues',issues)
